child_list.content: The Lazy Donkey
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
Once, a donkey didn’t want to work. He thought, “If I pretend to be sick, I won’t have to carry heavy loads.” So, he lay down and acted very sick. His owner was worried and decided to let him rest. The next day, the owner needed to go to the market. The owner said, “I’ll go without the donkey.” He took a horse and left. The donkey was happy and rested all day. But later, he heard about the amazing places the owner visited. There were fun fairs and delicious

foods. The donkey felt sad. He had learned that being lazy made him miss something wonderful.

child_list.content: 懒惰的驴子
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 从前，一头驴不想干活。他想：“如果我假装生病，我就不用搬那么重的东西了。”于是，他躺下装出一副病得很重的样子。他的主人很担心，决定让他休息。第二天，主人要去集市。主人说：“我不带驴去了。”他骑上一匹马离开了。驴子很高兴，休息了一整天。但后来，他听说了主人去过的那些神奇的地方。那里有游乐场和美味的食物。驴子很伤心。他明白了，懒惰会让他错过一些美好的东西。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
